answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 59924 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: sawm time Question: Where it is written that fasting time starting and end in which Hadith book, how about the six months day or night continuously fasting time. Answer ID: 59924 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1161/1118/L=09/1436) The starting and ending time of sawm is mentioned in the holy Quran: حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّواْ الصِّيَامَ إِلَى الَّليْلِ [البقرة : 187] (2) People living in such areas shall follow the timetable of the nearest cities of their country. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
